feature: ADR-0099 single bounded background Linux configuration file source
abi: No new unsafe/FFI/external dependency, std OpenOptions with existing libc O_NONBLOCK; existing C oracle rerun.

windows.scope: Linux-only source not implemented on Windows; previous shared/native validations pending approval quota issue.

limitations: One running job or ready result per owner; not global bound on caller-created owners.
Regular filesystem IO/allocator/thread scheduling/completed join have no hard time bound. NONBLOCK avoids FIFO open waiting, not filesystem stalls.
before/after/path metadata rejects observable changes, not atomic/ABA/authenticated content; raw bytes need worker compile and actual ack.
Close cannot preempt IO; retain same owner to reap/discard late result. Drop may detach, not task/process/global recovery proof.
Errors/debug contain metadata only; global panic hook behavior not controlled.
Source threads must start after HostSignals installation and worker spawn; no file completion can renew progress/watchdog.
Own temporary files/dirs/symlink/FIFO and threads only in new tests; no input/VT/uinput/driver/install actions.
Watcher/debounce/host integration/user reload operation remain unfinished along with original cross-platform scope.
